comment.body: The Windows 10 version and the attached report are useful, but the current text does not identify which PowerToys surface is clicked or whether the process starts. Please reply in English with numbered steps naming the exact target (tray icon, Settings shortcut, Start menu, or executable), what appears on screen, and whether PowerToys.exe appears in Task Manager. Then reproduce once and submit `/bugreport` immediately afterward. This will distinguish an installation/startup failure from a Settings-window or shell-launch problem; the prior sanitized report contained only environment metadata and no error signature.
